Help.pageSubtitle: Frequently asked questions about Ultra AutoTrade

faqs.item1Answer: Health Factor is a safety metric for collateral in Aave. If it falls below 1.0, liquidation risk arises. Our system automatically manages it to stay at 1.6 or above.
faqs.item2Question: What happens if HF drops below 1.6?
faqs.item2Answer: The system switches to SAFE_MODE and halts new deposits. If necessary, positions are automatically reduced. If HF falls below 1.3, HARD_STOP (full withdrawal) is triggered.
faqs.item3Question: What should I do if an emergency stop is triggered?
faqs.item3Answer: All automated trading stops. Your funds remain safely held in Aave. An administrator will review the situation and manually resume operations. No action is required from the user.
faqs.item4Answer: The USDC supply rate on Aave fluctuates based on market supply and demand. When borrowing demand decreases, the rate drops. The AI monitors market conditions and aims to operate at the optimal timing.
faqs.item5Question: What should I do if I want to stop using the service?
faqs.item5Answer: Please contact the administrator. They will handle the withdrawal from Aave. Your funds will be returned to your wallet.
faqs.item6Question: How often does the AI make decisions?
faqs.item6Answer: Market analysis and decisions are performed automatically every 4 hours. You can check the results on the dashboard.
faqs.item7Question: Is there a deadline for approving trades?
faqs.item7Answer: In active mode, please approve or reject AI proposals within 1 hour. Requests will be automatically cancelled on timeout.
faqs.item8Question: What is the minimum investment amount?
faqs.item8Answer: There is no minimum during the test period. The minimum for the production environment will be communicated separately.
faqs.item9Question: What is the difference between testnet and production?
faqs.item9Answer: Testnet uses virtual funds for operational verification. Production uses real USDC. The operation is the same, but gains and losses on testnet do not affect real assets.
faqs.item10Question: Who should I contact if a problem occurs?
faqs.item10Answer: Please contact the Slack #ultra-auto-project channel or the project representative directly. Including a screenshot of the error and steps to reproduce it will help us respond quickly.

minAmount.q: What is the minimum amount to start?
minAmount.a: There is no minimum, but we recommend at least 100 USDC to offset gas fees. With small amounts, gas costs can eat into returns.

lossRisk.q: Is there a risk of loss?
lossRisk.a: Yes. DeFi investing with crypto assets carries the risk of losing principal. AI helps optimize decisions, but market risk, smart contract risk, and liquidation risk exist. Please read the risk disclosure.

aiAutoTrade.a: No. The AI only makes "proposals." Any deposit or withdrawal requires your signature (approval) in MetaMask. Assets never move without your sign-off.

howToStop.q: How do I stop using the service?
howToStop.a: You can withdraw your assets from Aave at any time. Even after cancelling Ultra AutoTrade, your assets remain in your wallet. You only need gas fees to withdraw.

PrivacyPolicy.section1Title: 1. Information Collected and Purpose of Use
PrivacyPolicy.section1Intro: Ultra AutoTrade (hereinafter "the Service") collects the following information.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Item1: Wallet address (used for connecting to DeFi protocols)
PrivacyPolicy.section1Item2: Transaction history and operation logs (used for service quality improvement and fraud detection)
PrivacyPolicy.section1Item3: Browser type and IP address (used for security monitoring)
PrivacyPolicy.section1Footer: Collected information is used solely for the purpose of operating, improving, and ensuring the security of the Service. We do not collect personally identifiable information such as names or email addresses.
PrivacyPolicy.section2Body: Wallet addresses are public blockchain identifiers used for connecting to the Service and recording transaction history. Your private key is never transmitted to or stored on our servers. You are solely responsible for managing your wallet.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Intro: The Service uses cookies and browser local storage for the following purposes.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Item3: Recording consent to terms of service and settings
PrivacyPolicy.section3Footer: If you disable cookies in your browser settings, some features may not function properly.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Intro: The Service integrates with the following third-party services, and their respective privacy policies apply when using them.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Item1: Smart contracts are called on the blockchain for DeFi asset management. Transactions are recorded on the public blockchain.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Item2: This is an intermediary service for wallet connections. Connection information passes through WalletConnect's servers. Please refer to WalletConnect's privacy policy for details.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Footer: Information provided to these third-party services is limited to what is necessary for providing the Service's functionality.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Intro: Collected information is retained for the following periods.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Item1: Transaction history and operation logs: 1 year from last access
PrivacyPolicy.section5Item2: Session information: 30 days after session ends
PrivacyPolicy.section5Item3: Local storage data: Until you delete your browser data
PrivacyPolicy.section5Footer: After the retention period, data will be deleted in a secure manner.
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item1: Right to request disclosure of collected information
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item2: Right to request correction of inaccurate information
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item3: Right to request deletion of information
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item4: Right to object to data processing
PrivacyPolicy.section6Footer: To exercise these rights, please contact us at the contact information below.
PrivacyPolicy.section7Body: The Service implements industry-standard security measures to protect collected information from unauthorized access, leakage, and tampering. However, we cannot guarantee complete security on the internet.
PrivacyPolicy.section8Body: This policy may be changed with prior notice. If there are significant changes, we will notify you on the Service. If you continue to use the Service after changes are made, you will be deemed to have agreed to the revised policy.
PrivacyPolicy.section9Body: For questions or requests regarding this policy, please contact the Service's support team. When contacting us, please provide your wallet address and the content of your request.
